item.kultivator.blank_talisman.source: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 242 "Making Talismans" (blank paper from spirit herbs of a certain maturity, cinnabar from spirit-beast blood); red dye stands in for the cinnabar.
item.kultivator.thunder_talisman.source: Source: Inspired by Dragon War God ch. 498 (the Nine Heavens Thunder Talisman, runes turning into tendrils of electricity) and A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 1367 (lightning beads refined with lightning symbols).
item.kultivator.fire_cloud_talisman.sour: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 242 (Fire Cloud, an elementary high-grade talisman).
item.kultivator.shield_talisman.source: Source: A Will Eternal ch. 51 (talismans slapped onto the body raise shields almost two metres thick; also ch. 346, 560).
item.kultivator.binding_talisman.source: Source: Inspired by Ancient Strengthening Technique ch. 421 (a Binding Talisman lowers the opponent's speed).
item.kultivator.return_talisman.source: Source: Inspired by RMJ: Immortal Realm ch. 289 (a golden talisman bursts into golden flames and its user reappears thousands of km away) and Renegade Immortal ch. 12, 27 (thousand-mile talismans for trips home).
item.kultivator.tribulation_ward_talisma: Source: Inspired by I Shall Seal the Heavens ch. 159 (a wooden slip glows blue and seems able to repel lightning).
item.kultivator.thousand_mile_talisman.s: Source: Renegade Immortal ch. 12 (usable twice; for normal people it raised their speed).
item.kultivator.limpidity_talisman.sourc: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 1365 (a concealment talisman hides its user from mid-Spatial Tempering cultivators and weaker).

kultivator.screen.help.jimat.title: Talismans
kultivator.screen.help.jimat: Craft Blank Talismans from 3 paper, 1 Spirit Grass and 1 red dye (3 at once). Hold a blank in your main hand and a catalyst in your offhand, then sneak and use: after 2 seconds the qi and one catalyst are spent and the talisman gets a power equal to your realm (a beast core of the matching element as catalyst gives +1, High or King cores +2, at most 9). Success starts at 60% and rises with your talisman skill to 95%; a failure burns paper and catalyst to ash. Anyone, even a Mortal, can use a talisman: Thunder (a bolt that chains once), Fire Cloud (a cone of fire on monsters only), Shield (Absorption, not during a tribulation), Binding (Slowness and Weakness), Return (5 s channel home to your cave abode, respawn point or world spawn in this world, 10 min cooldown), Tribulation Ward (your next tribulation strike ×0.5, 2 per tribulation), Thousand Mile (Speed II, two uses) and Limpidity (invisible, monsters lose your trail). Talismans only hit monsters and never touch a block. Sources: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 222, 242, 765, 1346, 1365, 1367; A Will Eternal ch. 51; Renegade Immortal ch. 12, 27, 31; inspired by Dragon War God ch. 498, Ancient Strengthening Technique ch. 421, RMJ: Immortal Realm ch. 289 and I Shall Seal the Heavens ch. 159.
